changes.old_rule: Every completed player add was treated as carrying a separate $1 real-money transaction fee, with waiver acquisitions costing that fee plus the winning FAAB bid.
changes.new_rule: There is no separate pickup transaction fee. Sparta FAAB dollars themselves are real dollars. After the Sep. 15 Week 2 FAAB run, every pickup going forward requires a minimum $1 FAAB bid; a waiver acquisition costs only its winning FAAB bid. Pre-transition Week 1 pickups may have $0 FAAB cost.
changes.reason: Billy Enright's league-chat clarification supplied by the user showed that the prior repository interpretation double-counted the $1 minimum as an extra fee. This is a structural league-rules/data-integrity correction, so it is adopted immediately rather than waiting for repeated fantasy outcomes.
changes.expected_effect: Correct real-money accounting, eliminate systematic $1 overstatement of every future acquisition, and improve FAAB/churn learning metrics without changing the existing $12/$11/$7 waiver ladder.
